prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual blog cover for A2Z Skills. Contemporary flat gouache and cut-paper editorial illustration; crisp dark navy outlines; subtle paper grain; gently rounded friendly recognisable objects; sophisticated not childish; warm ivory background, cobalt blue with muted coral-orange, sage green and pale sky-blue; strong single focal metaphor; wide landscape 3:2; no text, lettering, logos, people, screenshots, fake errors, numerical data, watermarks or decorative sparkles. Subject: A handwritten sheet and a pencil pass through a magnifying glass held above them; the glass contains an uncertain abstract split check/cross symbol, showing that automated judgement of human writing can be wrong. No words on the paper. A single polished original image for this article, not a collage of multiple covers. Keep all important objects inside the middle 80% for responsive cropping. The image should feel like part of one publication's illustration family.
